name: WA · D Notifications
description: WhatsApp support: staff notifications (Telegram) with facts and a dashboard link only.

parameters.query:
SELECT (SELECT app.notification_facts((p->>'conversation_id')::uuid) WHERE p->>'conversation_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$') AS f,
       app.setting('notifications') AS notify, app.setting('dashboard_url') #>> '{}' AS dash FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
